title: Wire Optimize quality gates to eval-harness + retries/timeouts/artifact capture
author: Olivia Grant
description: Context: Optimize quality gates require running offline evals on proposed config diffs (batching/caching/quant profile changes). eval-harness now exposes a trigger endpoint (see eval-harness PR #412) but Optimize still needs to: (1) invoke the endpoint with the right baseline + diff, (2) handle retries and timeouts without double-triggering runs, (3) persist artifacts/links for Console, and (4) classify failures into actionable reasons (capacity vs harness error vs invalid payload) for gate state machine transitions. This PR adds an eval-harness client and integrates it into the gate execution path in Optimize. Summary of changes: - Adds EvalHarnessClient with request signing, idempotency keys, request/response typing, and a small set of error types that the state machine can act on. - Implements retry policy with exponential backoff + jitter for transient errors (5xx, network timeouts, 429), bounded by a max wall-clock deadline per gate. - Adds explicit timeouts: connect timeout 2s, per-request timeout 30s, overall gate trigger deadline 4m (smoke) / 15m (full) (values configurable). - Adds cancelation propagation: when a gate run is canceled from Optimize, we attempt best-effort cancel on eval-harness (if run id known); otherwise we mark as canceled locally and rely on harness TTL to reap. - Captures artifacts from eval-harness response (result json, prompt-set ids, run url, blob pointers) and stores them on GateRun for Console consumption. - Improves failure-mode handling: maps eval-harness errors into gate failure reasons (EVAL_HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE, EVAL_HARNESS_TIMEOUT, INVALID_EVAL_REQUEST, EVAL_RUN_FAILED, ARTIFACTS_MISSING) and ensures we do not erroneously mark as regression failure when the harness itself failed. - Adds structured logs + trace spans around trigger/run polling and includes correlation fields (gate_run_id, optimize_reco_id, route_id, model_id, baseline_id, harness_run_id). Out of scope: This PR does not change pass/fail thresholds, scoring logic, or Console UI. It focuses on reliable execution + artifact capture. Implementation notes: - Uses the config-diff schema introduced in PR #19511 for payload generation and runs Optimize-side static validation before calling eval-harness (to reduce wasted GPU). - Uses an Idempotency-Key header derived from gate_run_id + attempt group; eval-harness treats repeated keys as safe replays returning the same harness_run_id. - Retry is only enabled before we have a harness_run_id. Once we have a run id, we poll status rather than re-triggering. - Polling cadence starts at 2s and backs off to 15s; polling stops at overall deadline and returns TIMEOUT with partial artifacts (if any). - Artifact capture is resilient: missing non-critical artifacts do not fail the gate, but missing the primary results payload does (ARTIFACTS_MISSING). Testing: - Unit tests for retry classification and idempotency behavior. - Contract tests against a local eval-harness stub (recorded fixtures) to validate payload + response parsing. - One integration test in staging to confirm artifacts show up in GateRun API. Rollout plan: - Behind feature flag optimize.gates.eval_harness_enabled (default off). - Enable in staging for internal routes, then enable for 5% of hosted routes during beta; SRE will watch harness 5xx/timeout rates and Optimize gate latency. Risks: - Potential thundering herd if eval-harness has a partial outage. Mitigation: retry budget + circuit breaker (simple rolling window) added; when open, gate transitions to HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE and does not spam retries. - Misclassification of failures could cause false gate failures. Mitigation: errors are surfaced with reason + raw harness status code in GateRun debug fields, and we keep harness error distinct from regression failures. References: - Linear: ENG-3921 / ENG-3922 - Related PRs: redwood#19502 (state machine), redwood#19511 (schema/validation), eval-harness#412 (trigger endpoint)

review_conversation: Jonas Weber: Can we ensure we never re-trigger eval runs after we have a harness_run_id? Otherwise we risk burning GPU and confusing comparisons.
Olivia Grant (author): Yep — retries only happen prior to receiving harness_run_id. After that we only poll /run/{id} and treat trigger as complete. Added an assertion + test to prevent regressions.
Yara Haddad: Artifact handling: if artifacts are missing, should the gate be FAILED or HARNESS_ERROR? Also want Console to show something useful.

Olivia Grant (author): Split into ARTIFACTS_MISSING (treated as harness error, not regression). Gate state machine maps that to FAILED_INFRA, and we store partial fields (harness_run_url, prompt_set_ids) when present so Console can still link out.
Ethan Park: Please confirm auth/signing matches our internal service-to-service standard. Also should include route/account identifiers for debugging but avoid logging prompts.

Olivia Grant (author): Uses the existing internal JWT service token + audience eval-harness, and we only log ids (gate_run_id, route_id, model_id, baseline_id). No prompts or responses in logs; artifacts remain in blob storage behind ACLs.
Allison Grant: Metrics/tracing: please add a span for trigger vs poll so we can isolate where time is spent. Also ensure 429 retry doesn’t create alert noise.

Olivia Grant (author): Added spans optimize.gates.harness.trigger and optimize.gates.harness.poll with status tags. Retries include attempt counters and we cap retry budget; 429s are tracked but not logged at error level unless budget exhausted.
Connor O'Brien: CI note — the staging smoke check failed once due to a 502. Can we make that check more deterministic or mark as flaky?
Olivia Grant (author): For now I reran; longer-term we should point the check at the stubbed harness. Filed follow-up in ENG to move staging smoke off shared harness. (Not blocking this PR.)
Jonas Weber: Looks good from eval methodology perspective; important that harness failures aren’t counted as quality regressions.
Yara Haddad: Approved once the ARTIFACTS_MISSING mapping landed.
release_notes: Internal: Optimize quality gate execution now calls eval-harness reliably with retries/timeouts and records artifact links on GateRun. No customer-facing behavior change until feature flag is enabled.
